name: duckling_crest_puff_mk2
rationale: Revision after round-0 needs-review (recipe 47de1147…): renders confirm the crest is connected and non-obstructive but reads as a tiny speck; attempt-0 failed in CAD. Diagnosis of attempt-0: the 16x13x11 center puff tilted -15deg has a rotated Z half-extent of ~7.4 mm about center z=5.5, driving its lowest Z to ~-1.9 mm — below Z=0, invalid. Fix: keep the enlarged friendly silhouette but tilt the center puff only -10deg and raise it to z=7 (lowest Z ~+0.19 mm, inside the 3 mm base with full XY overlap, positive volume). Side puff (Y=+4 only, host mirrors bilaterally) raised to z=6 with milder rotations, lowest Z ~+1.4 mm, overlapping the 18x16 base in XY. Front accent puff at [4,3,5] with gentle 10deg tilt keeps lowest Z ~+1.9 mm. No feature reaches below Z=0; whole part ~18x16x~13 mm sits well inside 80x80x35 mm, mass far under 16 g. Soft rounded ellipsoid tuft, no sharp silhouettes; clear of the front camera lens and dome seen in +X and perspective views. Adhesive-pad attachment, curvature fit, printability and walking remain open per the brief.
